mapper.select: select coverage_code, coverage_category_code, coverage_name, duplicate_group_code, description, search_keywords_json, is_active, compensation_type, duplicate_rule_code, recommendation_rule_code, created_at, updated_at from ref_coverage where is_active = true order by coverage_code

select cp.capsule_product_id as product_source_id, cp.capsule_code, cp.product_name, ps.company_name, cp.coverage_category_code, ps.coverage_name, cp.coverage_code, cp.coverage_amount, cp.coverage_unit, cp.monthly_price_male, cp.monthly_price_female, cp.min_retention_days, cp.sale_status, cp.is_duplicate_check_target, cp.terms_uri, cp.terms_version, cp.description, cp.created_at, cp.updated_at from capsule_product cp left join insurance.product_source ps on ps.product_source_id = cp.capsule_product_id where cp.sale_status = 'AVAILABLE' order by cp.capsule_product_id

select cp.capsule_product_id as product_source_id, cp.capsule_code, cp.product_name, ps.company_name, cp.coverage_category_code, ps.coverage_name, cp.coverage_code, cp.coverage_amount, cp.coverage_unit, cp.monthly_price_male, cp.monthly_price_female, cp.min_retention_days, cp.sale_status, cp.is_duplicate_check_target, cp.terms_uri, cp.terms_version, cp.description, cp.created_at, cp.updated_at from capsule_product cp left join insurance.product_source ps on ps.product_source_id = cp.capsule_product_id where cp.capsule_product_id = #{productSourceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.capsule_product ( capsule_product_id, capsule_code, product_name, coverage_category_code, coverage_code, coverage_amount, coverage_unit, monthly_price_male, monthly_price_female, min_retention_days, sale_status, is_duplicate_check_target, terms_uri, terms_version, description ) SELECT ps.product_source_id, 'AUTO-PS-' || ps.product_source_id::text, ps.product_name, ps.coverage_category_code::text::coverage_category_code_enum, CASE WHEN rc.coverage_code IS NOT NULL THEN ps.coverage_code WHEN ps.coverage_category_code::text = 'CANCER' THEN 'CANCER_DIAGNOSIS' WHEN ps.coverage_category_code::text = 'DEATH' THEN 'DEATH_GENERAL' WHEN ps.coverage_category_code::text = 'SURGERY' THEN 'SURGERY_GENERAL' WHEN ps.coverage_category_code::text = 'BRAIN_HEART' THEN 'BRAIN_HEART_GENERAL' WHEN ps.coverage_category_code::text = 'ACTUAL_LOSS' THEN 'ACTUAL_LOSS_GENERAL' WHEN ps.coverage_category_code::text = 'ACCIDENT' THEN 'ACCIDENT_INJURY' ELSE 'LIABILITY_GENERAL' END AS coverage_code, 1000000::numeric(18,2), 'KRW', COALESCE(ps.monthly_premium_male, 0), COALESCE(ps.monthly_premium_female, ps.monthly_premium_male, 0), 30, 'AVAILABLE', TRUE, CASE WHEN ps.product_name = '무배당 삼성화재 펫보험 의기냥냥(2601.2)' THEN '/terms/samsung-fire-pet/index.html' ELSE NULL END AS terms_uri, 'auto-v1', 'Auto-synced from insurance.product_source for subscription flow.' FROM insurance.product_source ps LEFT JOIN public.ref_coverage rc ON rc.coverage_code = ps.coverage_code WHERE ps.product_source_id = #{productSourceId} ON CONFLICT (capsule_product_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.sql:
FROM insurance.product_source ps LEFT JOIN public.capsule_product cp ON cp.capsule_product_id = ps.product_source_id AND cp.sale_status = 'AVAILABLE' WHERE 1=1
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.myd_contract mc WHERE mc.user_id = #{userId} AND mc.contract_status_code IN ('NORMAL', 'ACTIVE', 'IN_FORCE') AND ( mc.end_date IS NULL OR mc.end_date >= current_date ) AND regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(mc.product_name, '')), '\s+', '', 'g') = regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(ps.product_name, '')), '\s+', '', 'g') )
AND ps.coverage_category_code = #{category}::insurance.coverage_category_code
AND (ps.monthly_premium_male IS NOT NULL AND ps.monthly_premium_male > 0)
AND ps.monthly_premium_male <= #{maxPrice}
AND (ps.monthly_premium_female IS NOT NULL AND ps.monthly_premium_female > 0)
AND ps.monthly_premium_female <= #{maxPrice}
mapper.select:
SELECT ps.product_source_id, ps.company_name, ps.product_name, ps.insurer_sector::text as insurer_sector, ps.coverage_category_code::text as coverage_category_code, ps.coverage_code,
round(ps.monthly_premium_male, 0) round(ps.monthly_premium_female, 0) NULL AS monthly_price,
ps.price_index_male ps.price_index_female NULL AS price_index_text, COALESCE( cp.terms_uri, CASE WHEN ps.product_name = '무배당 삼성화재 펫보험 의기냥냥(2601.2)' THEN '/terms/samsung-fire-pet/index.html' ELSE NULL END ) AS terms_uri, ps.loaded_at, ps.updated_at
ORDER BY ps.product_source_id ASC

SELECT ps.product_source_id, ps.company_name, ps.product_name, ps.insurer_sector::text as insurer_sector, ps.coverage_category_code::text as coverage_category_code, ps.coverage_code,
round(ps.monthly_premium_male, 0) round(ps.monthly_premium_female, 0) NULL AS monthly_price,
ps.price_index_male ps.price_index_female NULL AS price_index_text, COALESCE( cp.terms_uri, CASE WHEN ps.product_name = '무배당 삼성화재 펫보험 의기냥냥(2601.2)' THEN '/terms/samsung-fire-pet/index.html' ELSE NULL END ) AS terms_uri, ps.loaded_at, ps.updated_at
ORDER BY monthly_price ASC NULLS LAST, ps.product_source_id ASC
ORDER BY monthly_price DESC NULLS LAST, ps.product_source_id ASC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT product_source_id, company_name, product_name, insurer_sector::text as insurer_sector, sale_channel, coverage_name, claim_reason, payout_amount, join_amount, minimum_join_premium, payment_cycle, payment_term, coverage_term, coverage_category_code::text as coverage_category_code, coverage_code, CASE WHEN #{gender} = 'M' THEN round(monthly_premium_male, 0) WHEN #{gender} = 'F' THEN round(monthly_premium_female, 0) ELSE 0.00 END as monthly_price, product_summary, product_feature, special_note, contact_phone, sale_date, current_announced_rate, fixed_rate, minimum_guaranteed_rate FROM insurance.product_source WHERE product_source_id = #{productSourceId}
